name: coslate-monorepo
description: CoSlate — an open interactive scene runtime (whiteboard core, not the whole product).

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @coslate/core build && pnpm --filter @coslate/konva build && pnpm --filter @coslate/ui build && pnpm --filter @coslate/demo dev
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/konva packages/ui && pnpm --filter @coslate/demo build
